case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a great long-term partner. Our options give you a clear way to do that: a firm quality commitment, with a chargeback of nothing per complaint, at a price we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Quality is the trade here, and it is worth the same to both sides: you carry no chargebacks, and we receive parts that run without complaints.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. Its quality commitment is far tighter than your own offer, and its price matches the price history above. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We expect a decisive answer on Option A.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the quality record and price history data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We checked the quality numbers and are ready to agree to the 1500 ppm commitment from your Option A. We can do 46.50 EUR for Option A, which is a fair step to get this moving.

Our main offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You said faster payment would help you most. That is not a term of this enquiry, so we keep the trade where it works for both sides: quality. Your readiness to agree to a firm quality commitment is the right step, and we take it seriously.

Your offer still sits well above what we can approve. Option A is the package we can approve: it holds the quality commitment at its strongest, with no chargeback per complaint, at a unit price that reflects that confidence in your own work.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.54.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.63.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.59.

Option A is the cleanest one for both of us.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Look, if we can't touch the payment terms, we need a price that works for our cash flow. We'll take your Option A with the tough 300 ppm target and 0 EUR chargeback. Best we can do to meet you in the middle is 46.00 EUR per unit.

So, our offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
